interface_debt.why: cfe.h is an umbrella header that pulls every cFE service, OSAL, mission configuration, and PSP header into all 16 consumers; any change to any included header, or any addition/removal of an include, forces all consumers to recompile and couples unrelated components to each other's evolution.
interface_debt.better: Make the per-service headers the public interface and keep cfe.h minimal or optional; applications should include only the cFE services, OSAL, or configuration they actually use.
interface_debt.title: cFE:modules/core_api/fsw/inc/cfe.h: cfe.h — one header carries unrelated responsibilities

interface_debt.why: Status is a raw 32-bit integer, so users can and likely do store it in int32 variables, print it with integer formats, compare it to integer literals, or manipulate its bits; if cFE later changes the status size, signedness, or encoding, those user assumptions break or silently misbehave.
interface_debt.better: Use a strong enum or opaque status type and expose only semantic predicates and accessors instead of a raw integer representation.
interface_debt.title: cFE:modules/core_api/fsw/inc/cfe_error.h: CFE_Status_t — a type fixes its representation (union for aliasing, fixed-size array, bitfield)

interface_debt.why: Users must provide a fixed 11-byte array for CFE_ES_StatusToString; if cFE later needs a longer string form, the public type and function signature force every user buffer and call site to change together.
interface_debt.better: Provide a conversion function that accepts a caller-provided buffer and size, or returns the required length, instead of a fixed array type.
interface_debt.title: cFE:modules/core_api/fsw/inc/cfe_error.h: CFE_StatusString_t — users reach into the layout of a type (public struct or union members)

interface_debt.why: Users may decode severity by masking with this exact bit pattern; if cFE moves the severity bits, widens the field, or adds severity values, user decode logic must be updated in lockstep.
interface_debt.better: Expose CFE_Status_GetSeverity(status) and keep the severity bit layout internal to cFE.
interface_debt.title: cFE:modules/core_api/fsw/inc/cfe_error.h: CFE_SEVERITY_BITMASK — users reach into the layout of a type (public struct or union members)

interface_debt.why: Users may classify or filter statuses by service using this fixed bit field; adding a cFE service or changing the service field position or width forces user code that extracts or filters service to change.
interface_debt.better: Expose CFE_Status_GetService(status) or an opaque service identifier and keep the service bit layout internal.
interface_debt.title: cFE:modules/core_api/fsw/inc/cfe_error.h: CFE_SERVICE_BITMASK — users reach into the layout of a type (public struct or union members)

interface_debt.why: This macro hard-codes the status-string buffer size for the current 0x%08x plus NUL format; any user that sizes buffers from it is frozen to that format, so a cFE change to a longer string requires changing the macro and all user buffer sizes.
interface_debt.better: Provide a length query such as CFE_ES_StatusToStringSize(status), or accept a caller buffer length in the conversion function.
interface_debt.title: cFE:modules/core_api/fsw/inc/cfe_error.h: CFE_STATUS_STRING_LENGTH — a macro hard-codes a size, an offset or a layout

interface_debt.why: A status-code header pulls OSAL into every user, coupling the cFE status contract to OSAL; if OSAL is unavailable, renamed, or its int32 type changes, all 16 repositories that include cFE_error.h are affected.
interface_debt.better: Make cFE_error.h self-contained, for example by including stdint.h or defining its own portable status type, and separate OSAL-dependent declarations from the status contract.
interface_debt.title: cFE:modules/core_api/fsw/inc/cfe_error.h: osapi.h — one header carries unrelated responsibilities

interface_debt.why: The application run status is exposed as a raw 32-bit integer pointer, so every consuming application main loop is coupled to cFE's numeric run-state encoding. If cFE later introduces a typed status enum or changes the state values, all applications must be changed and revalidated together.
interface_debt.better: Use a public typed status, e.g. bool CFE_ES_RunLoop(CFE_ES_RunStatus_t *RunStatus), and keep the numeric encoding private.
interface_debt.title: cFE:modules/core_api/fsw/inc/cfe_es.h: CFE_ES_RunLoop — a type fixes its representation (union for aliasing, fixed-size array, bitfield)

interface_debt.why: Exit status is a raw uint32, so user code can store, compare, or pass arbitrary 32-bit values. If cFE evolves the run-status representation or introduces a typed enum, every application exit path and any test harness fabricating exit statuses must change in lockstep.
interface_debt.better: Use void CFE_ES_ExitApp(CFE_ES_RunStatus_t ExitStatus) with a stable public enum or opaque status type.
interface_debt.title: cFE:modules/core_api/fsw/inc/cfe_es.h: CFE_ES_ExitApp — a type fixes its representation (union for aliasing, fixed-size array, bitfield)

interface_debt.why: The minimum system state is an untyped 32-bit value, freezing the numeric system-state machine in the public API. When cFE adds, reorders, or retypes system states, every application that waits for a named state must be updated even if it only uses symbolic constants.
interface_debt.better: Use a typed state parameter, e.g. CFE_Status_t CFE_ES_WaitForSystemState(CFE_ES_SystemState_t MinSystemState, uint32 TimeOutMilliseconds).
interface_debt.title: cFE:modules/core_api/fsw/inc/cfe_es.h: CFE_ES_WaitForSystemState — a type fixes its representation (union for aliasing, fixed-size array, bitfield)

interface_debt.quote: CFE_ES_DTEST(m[(s) / 32], (s) % 32)) /* Test a bit within an array of 32-bit integers.
interface_debt.why: The macro assumes the caller's mask is an array of 32-bit words and hard-codes division and modulo by 32. If cFE changes mask storage to 64-bit words, another word size, or a non-array representation, users of this macro must change their data layout and all mask code at the same time.
interface_debt.better: Hide mask layout behind a typed bitset object and accessor functions, or parameterize the word type and size instead of exposing a fixed 32-bit array layout.
interface_debt.title: cFE:modules/core_api/fsw/inc/cfe_es.h: CFE_ES_TEST_LONG_MASK — a macro hard-codes a size, an offset or a layout

If cFE standardizes to CFE_Status_t and typed reset values, users reading reset information must change their calls and variable types.
interface_debt.better: Use CFE_Status_t CFE_ES_GetResetType(CFE_PSP_ResetType_t *ResetType, CFE_PSP_ResetSubtype_t *ResetSubtypePtr) so status and data are both typed.
interface_debt.title: cFE:modules/core_api/fsw/inc/cfe_es.h: CFE_ES_GetResetType — a declaration whose meaning or signature is likely to change

interface_debt.why: The numeric enum value is part of the public contract and is used as the count of supported algorithms; adding a new CRC algorithm before MAX changes MAX and any values derived from it, breaking apps or telemetry that store numeric CRC types.
interface_debt.better: Assign fixed numeric values to all CRC types and use a separate maximum or sentinel that does not drive other values.
interface_debt.title: cFE:modules/core_api/fsw/inc/cfe_es_api_typedefs.h: CFE_ES_CrcType_MAX — a type fixes its representation (union for aliasing, fixed-size array, bitfield)

interface_debt.why: An unimplemented historical CRC value is kept alive and must remain nonzero; because it is derived from MAX, any evolution of the supported CRC list forces coordinated changes in users that depend on these legacy symbols.
interface_debt.better: Isolate legacy symbols in a compatibility header with fixed values and a deprecation path, or remove them once users are migrated.

interface_debt.quote: CFE_Status_t CFE_EVS_Register(const void *Filters, uint16 NumEventFilters, uint16 FilterScheme);
interface_debt.why: The filter array is passed as an untyped void pointer whose layout is selected by FilterScheme, so users must construct filter structs from external knowledge; any change to the binary filter layout or addition of a scheme forces all apps that register filters to update their setup and can silently change filtering behavior.
interface_debt.better: Expose a stable, typed filter descriptor or per-scheme typed registration API so the compiler can check the filter layout and new schemes can be added without reinterpreting user memory.
